description: A document with nothing sensitive, to catch over-redaction
marked: Please summarise the attached product brochure and list the three key features in plain English. The brochure describes a standing desk range with adjustable height, cable management and a ten-year warranty. No customer details are involved.

description: Identifier-shaped strings that are NOT sensitive — false-positive bait
marked: Order reference X123456 was shipped under tracking code AB998877 on the 4th. Product SKU Z999999 is discontinued. The meeting room is 2301 and the extension is 4021. Serial number K470285 has no check digit and is not an identity number.

description: Follow-up note where a name is introduced with a role word and then used bare — the shape anchored rules alone cannot cover
